cards.title: Add macro market compositing rule
cards.finding_name: Macro Overall Market Outlook — 0% Win Rate
cards.finding_summary: Macro 'overall market outlook' predictor is 0/3 on bearish calls. No cross-sector compositing rule exists — sector-level signals (Iran strikes, European gas spike) are correctly routed individually but not chained into a coherent market-level view.
cards.recommendation: Create a rule that composes sector-level signal aggregations into a market-level confidence score before issuing macro direction calls. Weight the most-confident sector signals, not a blanket bearish sentiment.

cards.title: Add signal conflict-resolution step in energy sector predictor
cards.finding_name: Confidence Does Not Predict Accuracy — Energy Sector
cards.finding_summary: Energy sector predictor has 33% win rate despite 68% avg confidence. Two high-confidence bearish signals (0.85 each) on Iran/geopolitical energy themes conflicted with bullish predictions. No conflict-resolution logic within sector.
cards.recommendation: Add conflict-resolution step: when multiple signals with >0.70 confidence point in opposite directions for the same sector, the predictor should either reduce confidence or split into directional sub-predictions.

cards.title: Add new signal event types: analyst_initiation, analyst_rating_maintenance, index_inclusion, ceo_transition, cfo_resignation
cards.finding_summary: 576/2000 sampled signals are 'other'. Recurring misclassifications: analyst initiations (Rosenblatt Airbnb buy), S&P 500 inclusions (BE/EVER/ILMN), CFO buys/sells, CEO transitions. Systematic patterns need dedicated event types.
cards.recommendation: Add signal classification rules for: analyst_initiation, analyst_rating_maintenance, index_inclusion, ceo_transition (separate from leadership_transition), cfo_resignation (separate — historically more bearish per indirect dependency ID 220).

cards.title: Audit and fix inconsistent insider_trading tagging
cards.finding_summary: Medalist CFO buy and Nurix CSO sell both fell to 'other' despite being clear insider transactions. System has some insider_trading tagging but coverage is incomplete.
cards.recommendation: Audit signal classifier for insider_trading coverage. Ensure all CFO/CSO buy/sell transactions are tagged insider_trading, not 'other'.
